text: これいじょうは　ない　くらい　なついて　いるのね…！

structure.jp: これいじょうは　ない　くらい
structure.en: to the point where there is nothing beyond this

structure.jp: なついて　いるのね…！
structure.en: it is attached to you, isn't it!

patterns.name: 〜くらい
patterns.span: これいじょうは　ない　くらい
patterns.explanation: くらい after a phrase means 'so much that' that phrase is true. これいじょうは　ない　くらい = 'so much that there is no more than this'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: て-form plus いる says the state is still true now. なついて　いる = 'is attached'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement gives it a tone of noticing or explaining; women often use it without だ. なついて　いるのね = 'so it is attached, I see'.
